_README: Media-type <-> file-extension table for the content-addressed attachment store.
This lives in JSON rather than inside attachmentStore.ts because TWO different
programs need it and they must agree exactly: the Next.js app (via
attachmentStore.ts) and the standalone migration script
If the two ever disagreed, identical bytes would be stored under two different
extensions -- the same payload written twice, and dedupe silently missing.
A ref's extension is also what the serving route reports as Content-Type.
Adding a format: add it to BOTH maps. Unknown types fall back to 'bin' /
'application/octet-stream', which is safe but not previewable in the browser.
